scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Actual compound Panda kinematics, same-held-row contact requalification and explicit incomplete free-body release diagnostics

selected_contact_qualification.scope: Check actual geometry, exact rigid jaw motion and nonlinear PD/bulk derivatives.
selected_contact_qualification.limitations: Open geometry and no-contact derivative/virtual-work checks qualify the independent kinematic actuator model. Active contact, finite-body deformation, fixture release, solver tolerance/regularization/history and corresponding rigid fixed-hand comparison remain required.

strict_rigid_fixture_geometry.scope: Corresponding rigid fixed-hand Panda fixture; retain original jaw PD and geometry.
strict_rigid_fixture_geometry.limitations: The hand is fixed; the original seven arm PD joints and soft finger-joint equality are omitted in this corresponding controlled fixture. Both jaws retain their own PD actuation and actual compound collision geometry. This is not full application equivalence.

direct_release_diagnostics.scope: Audit retained incomplete Panda closure/release states without accepting them.
direct_release_diagnostics.limitations: These fields come from incomplete free-body contact states. The held closure still contains support reactions. Neither state establishes complete equilibrium, spatial/regularization/history convergence or accuracy against the actual application. Force/moment residuals retain gravity and all nonlinear-body nodes.

least_squares_release_diagnostics.scope: Audit retained incomplete Panda closure/release states without accepting them.
least_squares_release_diagnostics.limitations: These fields come from incomplete free-body contact states. The held closure still contains support reactions. Neither state establishes complete equilibrium, spatial/regularization/history convergence or accuracy against the actual application. Force/moment residuals retain gravity and all nonlinear-body nodes.

summary.excluded_same_state_claim: Centred qualification v1 selected different held rows after QR pivot changes. Its numeric outputs are retained exactly but do not qualify an identical fixture. Selected v2 and the coordinate audit preserve all original held rows and reproduce the actual original failure residual.

limitations: Actual12-geom rigid Panda fingers and mass/PD kinematics are qualified. The source-coordinate numerical floor is requalified using identical held rows and unchanged1e-9N tolerance. The completed held closure still has support reactions; both original free-body release solvers fail and are unaccepted. A nonlinear peak interval or small deformation is not equilibrium evidence. Fixed-hand fixture omits full-arm PD and soft finger equality; its time history and omitted-feedback comparison remain required. Original v1 fixture/source-coordinate and wrong-held-row diagnostic attempts are preserved exactly. Live rigid fixture/rigid-mode solver and U/full-egg are excluded. Full physical/contact/model/cost acceptance remains incomplete. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
